passages.text: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
passages.note: partnership and shared purpose in relationships

passages.text: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say. Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts.
passages.note: choosing goodness and justice as a way to live

passages.text: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
passages.note: longing for justice and right living
